title: Nuvoro Page Transitions
description: A four-view site (home, work, studio, contact) where clicking a nav link runs a native View Transitions API page change: the incoming view is masked by a full-screen clip-path polygon that expands from a thin slit at 75% height to the whole viewport over 2s (cubic-bezier hop ease), while a dark GSAP revealer overlay scales away with a CustomEase 'hop' wipe and the new heading reveals through masked SplitText chars/words/lines on a power4.out stagger. Lenis drives smooth scrolling on the inner pages.

images.desc: brutalist concrete facade shot from below against a muted teal sky, deep geometric window bays in shadow
images.role: full-width hero image anchored to the bottom of the home view

images.desc: minimal grey concrete wall meeting at a soft edge, calm tonal light-and-shadow study
images.role: first project image ('Halden') in the vertical 'selected work' gallery

images.desc: underside of a curved white concrete canopy with a circular oculus opening onto bright sky
images.role: second project image ('Atrium') in the vertical 'selected work' gallery

images.desc: symmetrical brutalist concrete apex, chevron beams converging into a peaked opening
images.role: third project image ('Northbound') in the vertical 'selected work' gallery

images.desc: weathered concrete corner of a modernist building with two dark recessed windows, black-and-white
images.role: fourth project image ('Quarry') in the vertical 'selected work' gallery

images.desc: dark concrete wall with a sharp diagonal of light and a pale terrazzo ledge below, moody shadow study
images.role: about image in the second column of the studio view

intent.useWhen: Cuando quieres transiciones de página fluidas entre secciones, con un barrido clip-path oscuro y titulares que se revelan por líneas al llegar a cada vista.
